name: Saya
source:
A quiet and polite schoolgirl. She's not very social and Juri is one of her only friends. 

She's always humble and underestimates herself. Her daily life is pretty normal.

[Translated from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/requartz/character/saya.html]official website[/url]]
